headline: Serbia Cancels $500 Million Belgrade Trump Tower Development Project
summary: Plans to construct a $500 million Trump-branded hotel and residential complex in central Belgrade were halted. The cancellation follows a criminal investigation into alleged official abuse of power regarding the historic defense ministry site.
why: The project involved high-value foreign real estate development in Eastern Europe tied to the Trump Organization brand.

impacts.name: Serbia
impacts.why: Halting the $500 million complex ends a major foreign commercial real estate development in Belgrade.
